subject: real-estate
intro: Real estate studies leads to commission-based and salaried work moving, valuing, financing and managing property — the licensed agents, appraisers, lenders and managers behind every transaction.

roles.title: Real Estate Sales Agents
roles.entry: High school diploma or equivalent plus license
roles.what: Rent, buy or sell property for clients: study property listings, interview prospective buyers, accompany clients to sites, discuss conditions of sale and draw up real estate contracts, on either the buyer's or seller's side.
roles.where: The contracts and closing unit — purchase agreements, escrow, deeds and transfer — and the agency unit's duties and disclosure requirements are the exam content you will use with every client file.

roles.title: Real Estate Brokers
roles.entry: High school diploma or equivalent plus license
roles.what: Operate a real estate office or work for a commercial firm overseeing real estate transactions, usually selling real estate, renting properties and arranging loans, with agents working under their supervision.
roles.where: The agency and professional practice unit — agency relationships, disclosure, fair housing law — plus the contracts unit's closing mechanics are what brokers supervise agents on, and the finance unit backs the loan-arranging side.

roles.title: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
roles.what: Appraise real estate exclusively and estimate its fair value, and may assess taxes in accordance with prescribed schedules, for lenders, governments and buyers who need defensible values.
roles.where: The valuation and appraisal unit — the appraisal process, comparable sales, income and cost approaches — is literally the job, and the property and ownership unit's interests and encumbrances determine what a valuation can assume.

roles.title: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate the selling, buying, leasing or governance activities of commercial, industrial or residential properties, including managing homeowner and condominium associations, buildings and land.
roles.where: The property and ownership unit's forms of ownership and easements govern what managers administer, leases draw on the finance unit's interest and amortisation work, and fair housing law from the agency unit constrains daily decisions.

roles.title: Loan Officers
roles.what: Evaluate, authorise or recommend approval of commercial, real estate or credit loans, advising borrowers on financial status and payment methods — including mortgage loan officers and underwriters.
roles.where: The real estate finance unit — mortgages and notes, interest, amortisation and points, foreclosure and alternatives — is the technical heart of mortgage lending, and the contracts unit's closing process shows where the loan lands.
